events.text: Real-time model scored transaction 3478782 ($292.36, online) at 0.79. Review and decide.

events.msg: Core toolkit: flagged transaction, card window, card baseline, recurring charges, resolved account history, device neighbours, region activity and prior cases

hypotheses: Legitimate high-value purchase: The cardholder is making a genuine, one-off larger online purchase than their historical average.
Card-not-present (CNP) fraud: An unauthorized actor has obtained the card details and is attempting a larger online transaction before detection.
Account takeover (ATO) or card sharing: The card is being used by a family member or associate, or the account has been compromised, leading to an unusual spending pattern.

calls.why: To analyze the card's full transaction history, checking for recent location changes, velocity spikes, or other suspicious online attempts.
To check if there are any historical transactions of a similar amount on this card, which might indicate a recurring billing agreement.

events.msg: Four specialist analysts reviewing their evidence in parallel

events.assessment: The flagged transaction 3478782 represents a significant deviation from the card's historical baseline, with the amount ($292.36) being more than double the previous maximum transaction value of $121.32. While the real-time risk score is high at 0.79, the transaction model score is relatively low at 0.20, and the email domain (hotmail.com) matches the domain used consistently since mid-September.
key_points: Transaction 3478782 is for $292.36, which significantly exceeds the card's historical maximum transaction amount of $121.32.
The transaction model score (model_p) is low at 0.204461, contrasting with the high real-time risk score of 0.79.

The email domain associated with the card transitioned from anonymous.com in early transactions (e.g., 3230493) to hotmail.com starting with transaction 3272926 on 2016-09-16, which matches the flagged transaction.

events.assessment: The transaction 3478782 is flagged with a high real-time risk score of 0.79, but there is no device profile, proxy, or location data available to analyze for fraud indicators. The associated card account C11891-K1 has a very low activity history with only two transactions over 305 days, making it difficult to establish a normal behavioral baseline.

events.assessment: The transaction 3478782 is flagged at a high risk score of 0.79. The customer has a prior history of confirmed fraud under case CC-4160, which involved card_not_present_fraud on card C11891-K1. Given this history of account compromise, the current online transaction is highly suspicious and requires verification.
key_points: The customer associated with the alert has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4160) where card C11891-K1 was compromised via card_not_present_fraud.
The real-time risk score of 0.79 is elevated, aligning with the risk profile of previous fraud cases such as CASE-2016-014.
While some historically high-scoring alerts (like CC-2802 and CC-0265) were cleared as legitimate travel, the customer's specific fraud history increases the risk of repeat compromise.

events.claim: The transaction model trained on the bank's own closed cases (4,665 confirmed-fraud and 900 cleared investigations, July-October; October hold-out AUC 0.973) scores this transaction 0.204, against a 2.1% base rate. It reads the unnamed Vesta C/D/M/V columns, the identity record, running aggregates of the resolved account and the graph's memory of earlier closed cases, all as known at transaction time (it never sees the case outcome)
$292.36 is above every earlier purchase on this card (previous maximum $121.32)

initial.reason: R1: single signal (probability 0.20 < 0.70); verify before any block

confirm.reason: R3: the cardholder confirmed the transaction
R3: cardholder confirmed the purchase; amount unusual but consistent with their stated intent; confirmation noted in the case file

deny.reason: R2: the cardholder denied the transaction; exposure $292.36 is under $2,500
Section 3a: fraud confirmed or strongly suspected; record the investigation and write it to the graph

no_reply.reason: R4: no reply within 24 hours; raise monitoring for 72 hours

events.assumed_response: Cardholder confirmed the purchase; amount unusual but consistent with their stated intent

events.what_would_change_verdict: If the customer had denied the transaction or failed to respond within 24 hours, the verdict would change to fraud or suspected fraud, triggering R2 or R4 respectively.
